meaning: 随驯鹿一起走；顺势而为
usageNote: 这其实是个圣诞/童话风短语，平时不常用，但用来比喻'顺着某事走'超有画面感！

examples.en: When Santa asked for help, I decided to just go with the reindeer and join the adventure.
examples.zh: 当圣诞老人需要帮忙时，我决定顺势而为，加入这场冒险。

examples.en: Don't overthink it—sometimes you just have to go with the reindeer and see where it takes you.
examples.zh: 别想太多——有时候你就得随波逐流，看看会走到哪里。
